description: This file provides a mock data function 'getMockProducts' that returns an array of product objects with details such as id, name, category, description, image URL, price, weight/quality, and discount information. It serves as sample data for frontend components like ProductGrid and ProductDetail in a grocery shopping application.

methods.name: getMockProducts()
methods.description: Function that returns a fixed list of sample product objects with various attributes including discounts and categories.
